semiconductor_relevance: High — System General specializes in semiconductor testers and device programming, which are critical for the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: System General (SG) is a leading provider of device programming and semiconductor testing solutions, established in 1983. The company focuses on delivering high-quality products and services, supported by a skilled team in R&D, manufacturing, and technical support.

regional_presence.Taiwan: SG is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, where it manages its core operations.
regional_presence.United States: SG has a branch office in the USA to support its North American customers.
regional_presence.China: The company maintains a branch office in China to cater to the growing semiconductor market there.
